name: dotclaude-modder
description: Mods a PC game that you own: engine recon, game internals, fal assets, sprites, in-game tests, showcase videos, and field notes. Based on universal-modder by Rehan.

fal_key.title: fal API key
fal_key.description: The key from https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys. The fal MCP server and `um fal` use it. Without it, `um fal` reads `FAL_KEY` from the environment.
